hook: *112 mm* overnight in Keesara ends Hyderabad's dry spell
hook_b: Did your area flood last night? Keesara got *112 mm*
tldr: Heavy rain hit Hyderabad from Friday evening to Saturday morning. Keesara logged 112 mm; low-lying roads flooded.

beats.what: Friday night downpour: Keesara 112 mm, Bahadurpura 82.3 mm, Madhapur 73.8 mm (TSDPS data).
beats.why: A long hot, humid dry spell broke. IMD expects more evening showers with gusty winds.
beats.care: Leave early for evening plans. Skip underpasses and low roads after a shower.

cards.title: 🆕 Overnight totals (TSDPS)
cards.body: City: Keesara 112 mm · Bahadurpura (near Zoo Park) 82.3 mm · Abdullapurmet 76.5 mm · Madhapur (Kakatiya Hills) 73.8 mm · Shaikpet 67.5 mm. Districts: Valigonda 118 mm, Narketpalle 90.5 mm. Low-lying roads flooded; GHMC and traffic police cleared water in the morning rush.

cards.title: What's next
cards.body: Times of India reports IMD expects four more days of evening showers with gusty winds, and a yellow alert for districts around Hyderabad. No area-wise timings yet.

cards.q: How did last night's rain hit you?
Which spot got the most rain in Greater Hyderabad overnight?

viz.l: Keesara, Fri night to Sat morning

steps.e: More showers, gusty winds (IMD via TOI)

learn.t: TSDPS (Telangana State Development Planning Society) runs the state's automatic rain gauges. 100+ mm in a night counts as very heavy rain.

watch: IMD's daily bulletin for Hyderabad evenings through Nov 3.
